name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the agent to carry the box to the exit, but the hard Existence(holding_box) requires only that holding_box happens at least once, not that it happens on the last step. The Response(box_fell, holding_box) rule also allows holding_box to be true on the episode's last step, when the agent has failed to reach the exit. Add a hard Precedence(holding_box, at_exit) to the agent: this requirement is missing from the task. Keep the hard Existence(holding_box) and the hard Response(box_fell, holding_box).

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the agent to pick up the box and keep it until it reaches the exit. The hard Existence(holding_box) and ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) clauses are missing. The ChainResponse clause is also missing the event that triggers the chain, which is the agent picking up the box. The Precedence clause (holding_box, box_fell) is correct, but it should be applied only when the agent picks up the box. The RespondedExistence clause (siren_ringing, switch_toggled) is correct, but it is not necessary to silence the siren to reach the exit. The machine should be modified to include the missing clauses and to correctly apply the Precedence clause.

The box does not fall before the agent picks it up
The box does not fall while the agent is carrying it on the step that ends the episode
The agent silences the siren whenever it rings
